hebrewText: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע הָ/אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּ/ק֣וֹל מָנ֑וֹחַ וַ/יָּבֹ֣א מַלְאַךְ֩ הָ/אֱלֹהִ֨ים ע֜וֹד אֶל הָ/אִשָּׁ֗ה וְ/הִיא֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וּ/מָנ֥וֹחַ אִישָׁ֖/הּ אֵ֥ין עִמָּֽ/הּ

tokens.bdb: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] attentively, call (gather) together, [idiom] carefully, [idiom] certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, [idiom] diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), [idiom] indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, [idiom] surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.enLiteralWord: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.explanation: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.explanationEn: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, bleating, crackling, cry ([phrase] out), fame, lightness, lowing, noise, [phrase] hold peace, (pro-) claim, proclamation, [phrase] sing, sound, [phrase] spark, thunder(-ing), voice, [phrase] yell.

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.bdb: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)

gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.

tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
tokens.kjv: again, [idiom] all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further(-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more(-over), [idiom] once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within).

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
(adulter) ess, each, every, female, [idiom] many, [phrase] none, one, [phrase] together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
tokens.kjv: (make to) abide(-ing), continue, (cause to, make to) dwell(-ing), ease self, endure, establish, [idiom] fail, habitation, haunt, (make to) inhabit(-ant), make to keep (house), lurking, [idiom] marry(-ing), (bring again to) place, remain, return, seat, set(-tle), (down-) sit(-down, still, -ting down, -ting (place) -uate), take, tarry.
country, field, ground, land, soil, [idiom] wild.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: adverb or preposition, with (i.e. in conjunction with), in varied applications; specifically, equally with; often with prepositional prefix (and then usually unrepresented in English)
tokens.kjv: accompanying, against, and, as ([idiom] long as), before, beside, by (reason of), for all, from (among, between), in, like, more than, of, (un-) to, with(-al).
